lots.title: Stockport Town Centre School — Multi-Disciplinary Design Team (Architect, MEP, Structures & Civils, BR Principal Designer & CDM Principal Designer)
lots.description: Appointment of an architecturally led multi-disciplinary design and advisory team to support delivery of a new exemplar all-through town centre school in Stockport. The core team comprises Architect, MEP, Structural & Civil Engineer, BR Principal Designer and CDM Principal Designer, with additional disciplines and services to be reviewed/added at each RIBA Stage. The primary focus for RIBA Stage 2 is involvement from MEP and Structural Engineers, with future services agreed once tender is awarded and reviewed at each RIBA stage. The school is located on a previously developed brownfield site to the west of Stockport town centre and forms part of a wider regeneration programme led by Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council and the Stockport Mayoral Development Corporation.
requirements: Deliver an innovative all-through school (covering primary and secondary phases) serving current and future generations in Stockport town centre
Design must make a positive contribution to the town centre, complementing its unique character, historic townscape and skyline
Support inclusive and sustainable growth of adjacent communities by delivering necessary social infrastructure and education provision
Central accessible location with strong public transport links and connections to Brinnington; inclusive design meeting the needs of all learners
Green building standards, active travel promotion and flexible/adaptable spaces that can evolve with changing educational needs
Support curriculum innovation, technology integration and staff development
Additional disciplines beyond the core five to be appointed by the architect, either in-house or externally procured, to form the complete design team
Information sharing via SMBC SharePoint platform; BIM Level 2 with COBie data is a requirement

Compliance with RIBA Plan of Work and current Building Regulations, CDM 2015, Building Safety Act 2022, Building Regulations Approved Document B (Fire Safety), BS 9999, the Environment Act 2021, the Air Quality Standards Regulations 2010, inclusive design principles and BS 8300 (accessibility), and the Council's Climate Action Now and Social Value commitments
Suppliers must demonstrate how their approach contributes to sustainable design outcomes (environmental performance, energy efficiency, materials selection, long-term operational impact)
Architect: registered with ARB (Architects Registration Board); preferably chartered member of RIBA; MRICS or FRICS
MEP: CEng or IEng via Engineering Council UK; or MCIBSE/FCIBSE; or MIET; or MIMechE
Structural and Civils Engineer: registered with ICE and IStructE; preferably chartered member of ICE, IStructE or CIOB
Principal Designer (CDM 2015): membership of recognised body (RIBA, CIAT, ICE, IStructE); demonstrable CDM 2015 knowledge; SSIP accreditation (e.g. CHAS, SMAS, SafeContractor); PI insurance in place
Principal Designer (Building Safety Act 2022): competency standard PAS 8671:2022; in-house or specialist sub-consultant

Stage 1 participation requires written responses to competency questions via the Competitive Flexible Procedure with preliminary market engagement over 30 business days to shortlist a maximum of three suppliers

Stage 2 progression requires execution of a confidentiality / non-disclosure agreement given the sensitivity of the project, with detailed qualitative questions, pricing schedule and social value commitments
Performance monitored by the Authorised Officer with an agreed Performance Framework (Outcomes and KPIs) plus social, environmental and other monitoring processes throughout the contract

evidence_anchors.anchor_text: Document 2 Specification For: Stockport Town Centre School — Multi – Disciplinary Design Team (Architect, MEP, Structures & Civils, BR Principal Designer & CDM Principal Designer)
Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council (SMBC) is a unitary authority in Greater Manchester, serving a population of over 290,000 residents.
We are looking to deliver an innovative all through school, building on the current town centre regeneration and with an emphasis on providing a new educational vision for Stockport.

evidence_anchors.section_ref: 3.1 Business Objectives Relevant to this Procurement
evidence_anchors.anchor_text: Central location benefits; Inclusive design; Integration with town centre regeneration; Sustainability & Future Proofing; Educational excellence.

This procurement seeks to appoint an architecturally led multidisciplinary design and advisory team (initially including Architect, MEP, Structural and Civil Engineer, BR Principal Designer and CDM Principal Designer) to support the delivery of a new through school within the centre of Stockport.
It is anticipated that key information will be shared utilising SMBC SharePoint platform. BIM Level 2 with COBie data is a requirement.

All appointed consultants will be required to comply with: RIBA Plan of Work and current Building Regulations; CDM 2015 Regulations; Building Safety Act 2022; Climate Action Now and Social Value commitments; Approved Document B (Fire Safety); BS 9999; Environment Act 2021; Air Quality Standards Regulations 2010; Inclusive design principles and BS8300.

Stockport Council are commencing preliminary market engagement by issuing an Expression of Interest to suppliers through Stage 1 of the Competitive Flexible Procedure. 30 business days, maximum of three shortlisted suppliers.
Performance Measures Table: 1a Design Queries; 2 Design meets requirements; 3 Design meets budget; 4 Meetings; 5 Site Visits; 6 Pro-active duties; 7 Social Value. All Pass/Fail.

Standards: RIBA Plan of Work; CDM Regulations 2015; Building Safety Act 2022; Building Regulations (England and Wales); BS EN ISO 9001; Health and Safety at Work Act 1974; Equality Act 2010. Supplier may propose alternative standards with technical equivalence.
Design Team Appointment: April 2026. Stage 2 Design: Q2 2026 – Q3 2026.

Architect: ARB, preferably RIBA, MRICS/FRICS. MEP: CEng/IEng, MCIBSE/FCIBSE, MIET, MIMechE. Structural/Civils: ICE and IStructE registered, preferably ICE/IStructE/CIOB chartered. CDM Principal Designer: RIBA/CIAT/ICE/IStructE, SSIP (CHAS/SMAS/SafeContractor), PI insurance. BR Principal Designer: PAS 8671:2022.
7-point scoring matrix: Unacceptable 0, Poor 1, Deficient 2 (all excluded); Satisfactory 3, Good 4, Excellent 5, Outstanding 6. Stage 2 scoring released after NDA signed.
A Scope of Services: Architectural; BR Principal Designer; CDM Principal Designer; MEP; Structures and Civils.
